issues: This scope document is a 'Поверка средств измерений' (measurement-instrument calibration) table, not a typical ТР ТС product-conformity table: it has no norm_doc/okpd2/tnved columns, so those fields are null on every row. Column headers are №, 'Измерения, тип (группа) средств измерений' (split here into object=device/measurement group and indicator=measured substance/component), 'диапазон измерений' (parsed into range_from/range_to/unit), 'погрешность и/или неопределенность измерений (класс, разряд)' (metrological error/uncertainty, e.g. 'ПГ ±5% НКПР' — no schema field fits this, so it is preserved verbatim only in raw_row_text), and 'Примечание' (empty for all rows, shown as '-'). The full-width row 'ИЗМЕРЕНИЯ ФИЗИКО-ХИМИЧЕСКОГО СОСТАВА И СВОЙСТВ ВЕЩЕСТВ' is a category heading but does not match the ТР ТС/Раздел pattern, so tr_section is left null on all rows per instructions. Page 1 holds the full 3-row table; page 2 contains only signature blocks and seals, no table rows. Both pages fully read, no rotation or illegibility issues.
